title: Console sign-out: the login page's redirect carries the previous user's list filter, search and sort, so the next person who signs in on that browser opens their list state
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXSZs9PBUc2H8z6mtB

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing point and a reproduction (reach: the console's account-menu sign-out and the login form, measured 2/2 in fresh browser contexts with each identity proved by `GET /auth/get-session`).
Business reason: list state is per user on purpose. The checklist item says "a filter value can be sensitive" (a customer name, a deal size, a search term), and the per-user storage key exists to keep it from the next person on a shared machine. On a shared desk or kiosk browser, one person signs out and the next signs in on the page that opens; today that second person starts on the first person's filtered, searched and sorted list. This is a clause FAIL on a P1 item (records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder A3 and N2). The rows shown are still read under the second user's own permissions, so this is a state carry-over, not an access bypass.
Reader who acts: the ui lane (`ui/packages/app-shell`). Either sign-out drops the list's URL-mirrored state when it composes the login redirect, or the login page drops `uf__*` parameters when the signing-in user differs from the user who left. Add a test for the sign-out → different-user sign-in path.
Dedupe: `uf__filter` 4 hits (#29115 relative dates, #28971 personal views, #24616 and #27438 run records); `redirect sign out previous user` 111 and `login redirect list filter` 137 (run records and seat posts; nearest #26618, closed, single logout to the cloud, not this). No card covers this.

QA-source: #29172 · records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder · A3, N2

## What happens

Account A works on a list with a toolbar filter, a search and a sort, then signs out from the account menu. The login page opens at `/_console/login?redirect=` plus A's list URL, including its `uf__filter`, `uf__sort` and `uf__search` parameters. Account B signs in on that page and lands on A's list, with A's conditions, sort and search term on B's toolbar. B's first data request carries them.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02) on a stock showcase boot, Console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction

1. Boot the showcase. Mint a member B (invite, then sign-up).
2. In a fresh browser context, sign in through the form as admin (A). Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/in_progress`.
3. Add two filter-builder conditions (Estimate (h) greater than 10, Progress less than 80), search "pipeline", and sort Due Date newest first.
4. Account menu → **Sign out**. The URL is `/_console/login?redirect=…uf__filter…uf__sort…uf__search…`.
5. Sign in as B on that page.
6. **Expected:** B's view opens with B's own state, or the view default. Nothing A authored should appear.
7. **Actual:** B's toolbar shows A's two conditions, A's sort and "pipeline". B's first `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task` carries `search=pipeline&sort=-due_date&filter=[…estimate_hours>10…progress<80…]`.

The user-keyed storage is clean. A's `list-state:<A's id>` key and `sys_user_preference` row belong to A, B has neither, and B gets 404 on A's preference row. The URL is the only vehicle.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/LoginPage.tsx` L95 reads `?redirect=` and follows it verbatim after any successful sign-in.
- The signed-out guard composes that redirect from the full path and query. The list mirrors its state into the query (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/userFilterUrlState.ts`: `uf__filter`, `uf__search`, `uf__sort`), so sign-out hands the user's list state to whoever signs in next.
